svg.title: What Repayment Costs at Each Exit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-fca-repayment-multiplier-bands; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: What Repayment Costs at Each Exit; subtitle: Multiples of single damages quoted for disclosure, settlement, and judgment; total range: 1.25x to 3x single damages, before per-claim penalties; caption: The civil self-disclosure pilot prices repayment at 1.25 to 1.6x against typical FCA settlements at about 2x, while treble damages plus per-claim penalties await at judgment.; assumptions note: Multipliers are practitioner-quoted bands; per-claim penalties sit on top of the trebled figure and are not folded into the multiples.; note: Sources: Seyfarth Shaw LLP (Tori Young, QLVKZRh_ArE), ClearanceJobs (Julie Bracker, j_QEFJG-ON4), Justia (Hamilton and Newman, HocnawRgrAA).; buckets: label: Civil self-disclosure pilot; low: 1.25; high: 1.6; notes: No factual admissions, CIA, CMPs, or revocations; deadline April 22, 2027 (Tori Young).; label: Typical FCA settlement; low: 2.0; high: 2.0; notes: About 2x, the benchmark Tori Young contrasted with the pilot.; label: Government net after one-third relator cut; low: 2.0; high: 2.0; notes: Even at one-third, the government still nets double damages (Bracker).; label: Treble damages at judgment; low: 3.0; high: 3.0; notes: Plus $13,000 to $27,000 per claim as quoted by Hamilton and Newman.
